summary: Iteration 31: CRITICAL BUG FIX VERIFIED - Quote ID preservation after PUT updates. All 7 backend tests passed. Frontend PDF generation and quote editing working correctly for quotes with 15+ items.

quote_id_preservation: ✓ Create quote with 15 items → Edit → ID PRESERVED (same before and after edit)
✓ After editing, GET /api/quotes-v2/{id} still works with original ID
✓ After editing, POST /api/quotes-v2/{id}/generate-pdf still works with original ID
✓ Create quote → Edit 3 times → Each time ID stays same → Then generate PDF → Works
✓ Create quote with 20 items → Edit → ID preserved → PDF generated successfully
quotes_v2_endpoints: ✓ GET /api/quotes-v2/?doc_type=QUOTE returns JSON array without errors
✓ POST /api/quotes-v2/{id}/convert-to-po preserves document and creates new PO
frontend_verification: ✓ PDF button generates and displays PDF preview modal for quotes with 15+ items
✓ PDF modal shows filename PROFORMA_4740.pdf with Descargar button
✓ Edit page loads correctly for quotes with 15+ items

bug_fix_verification.root_cause: Quote.model_dump() generates a NEW UUID for 'id' field every time. On PUT (update), the $set operation was overwriting the original document ID with this new UUID.
bug_fix_verification.fix_code: quote_dict['id'] = existing.get('id', id)  # Preserve the original document id
bug_fix_verification.verification: All tests confirm ID is preserved after PUT updates. Quotes with 15-20 items can be edited multiple times and still be accessed via original ID.

critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIX VERIFIED: Line 181-182 in quotes_routes.py correctly preserves original ID
The fix quote_dict['id'] = existing.get('id', id) ensures the original document ID is never overwritten
All subsequent operations (GET, PDF, email) using the original ID now work correctly

success_rate.frontend: 100% (All quote editing and PDF generation tests passed)
